description:
`ProfilePackageSource` is replaced by the directory path it wraps, because its only variant is `Directory`.

## Background

`ProfilePackageSource` (`crates/jit/src/profile/package.rs:45`) has one variant, `Directory(PathBuf)`, destructured irrefutably at `crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs:1762,2310`. It is re-exported from `crates/jit/src/profile/mod.rs` and named in `crates/jit/tests/scratch_build/repository_state_cutover_tests.rs`. Line numbers are at the investigation baseline.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No `ProfilePackageSource` type remains; each former use holds the package directory path.
- [hard] REQ-02: Package loading behaves as before for each caller, shown by the existing package tests.
title: Unwrap the single-variant package source enum
